title: Te Reo Mārire o te Raorao
intro: Hoki whakamuri ki te wā o mua ki tētahi iwi nui i whiwhi i tētahi mea whakamiharo ora hei whakamātautau. Nā te whakapehapeha me te pakeke i hiri tō rātou aituā. Ka taea e koe te whai i te kōrero me te kite i ngā mea i puta i tēnei wā hurihanga whakamiharo?
clues: I tonoa mai ahau hei whakamātautau atua ki tētahi iwi nunui e mōhiotia ana mō tō rātou kaha me tō rātou māia.
He mīharo ahurei ahau—kāore anō kia puta mai he tangata pēnei i ahau i roto i a rātou.
I inu tahi mātou ko tōku iwi i te wai mai i te puna i ngā rā rerekē.
I whakatūpatohia rātou mēnā ka pā mai he kino ki ahau, ka tere tonu te whiu.
Ko te hunga tino maia o rātou i kore e aro ki te whakatūpato, ā, i whakamatea ahau.
I muri i tōku matenga, ka whakangaromia katoatia tōku iwi e te hamama nui mai i runga.

trial.label: Tōku Ao
options: I tiakina i te waipuke nui
I tere te kawe mai puta noa i tētahi rangatiratanga

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakangaromia e te hamama kotahi
I toremi i roto i te waipuke nui
I tahuna e te ua kohatu
I pakaruhia e te hau kaha
outcome.answer: I whakangaromia e te hamama kotahi

verse: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]. (54:29)
